lines.note: Crossing divisions: Ge'ez 1 includes the title and starts Greek 2; Ge'ez 2 finishes Greek 2 and starts Greek 3; Ge'ez 3 finishes Greek 3.
Ge'ez splits the new song and the many who see, fear, and trust into two verses.
Ge'ez splits the wonderful works from their declaration and number.
Crossing divisions: Ge'ez 10 joins the end of Greek 7 to the start of Greek 8; Ge'ez 11 finishes Greek 8 and includes Greek 9.
Ge'ez 12 includes 'my righteousness,' placed at the start of Greek 11; Ge'ez 13-14 contain the rest of Greek 11.
Ge'ez splits the encompassing evils and transgressions from the hairs of the head and failing heart.
Ge'ez separates those seeking to destroy the soul from those wishing evil.
Ge'ez separates being poor and needy from the appeal to God as helper and deliverer.
